text:
Hello 🙂

I previously lived in Germany for about five years on a student visa. I contacted the German Embassy with my questions, but I haven’t received any response, so I thought I’d ask in this group in case anyone has gone through the same process for the partnership process in Israel.
(I don’t currently have a German residence permit card or any other German identification.)

I have an appointment next week at the German Embassy in Israel to apply for a German Certificate of Good Conduct (Führungszeugnis).

I have a couple of questions:

1. What documents should I bring to the appointment?
    The instructions say I need to bring my passport, the application form, the original email, and the "necessary forms (consular attestation)". However, I’m not sure what exactly is meant by the last item. If anyone has been through this process, I’d really appreciate your advice.
2. How did you obtain the apostille?
    As I understand it, I need to apply separately through the German Federal Office for Foreign Affairs (BfAA). I’d love to hear about the actual process from anyone who has already done it.

I’d especially appreciate advice from non-German nationals who have applied for a German Certificate of Good Conduct through the German Embassy in Israel.

Thank you in advance!!
